notes.title: Major Update – BOT.vinnik Gets Even Sharper!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow chess enthusiasts,



Check out what's new:

🔊 New BOT.vinnik Reactions: We imported all the updated quotes and reactions directly from our newest game, making our beloved robot instructor even more expressive and sarcastic than ever.

✏️ Comprehensive Text Revision: Conducted a thorough review of all content, eliminating typos, improving syntax, and making texts clearer and more enjoyable.

🖥️ Windowed Mode: You can now easily switch between fullscreen and windowed mode by pressing ALT + ENTER.

🛠️ Bug Fixes: Addressed issues related to incorrectly swapped achievements.

📈 Gameplay Flow Improvements:

Clarified when clicks are necessary to proceed.

Immediate feedback for correct moves, removing the need to wait for previous incorrect comments.

🎨 Minor Visual Refinements: Subtle adjustments behind the chessboard for an improved visual experience.

🚀 New Splash Screen: Featuring our updated studio brand, Deep Green Games!



And there’s more coming soon: in just one week, we’ll be releasing the demo of our newest title, BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy"][/dynamiclink]

Thanks for all the support, and see you on the chessboard!

— The Deep Green Games Team

notes.title: The BOT.VINNIK you’ve been waiting for is finally here!
notes.content:
Hello, comrades!

You may have noticed we’ve been radio silent for a while—but there’s a good reason: we’ve spent the last few years working on the most ambitious BOT.VINNIK project to date!

🎉 BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/

This new game is the culmination of everything we’ve learned from the previous titles in the series. Alongside a brand-new visual style, it features:


 A reworked scoring system

 Structured progression across lessons

 Multiple difficulty levels

 A growing platform powered by future DLCs

 And even a beginner mode for those who don’t know how the knight moves yet


Of course, BOT.VINNIK’s trademark sarcasm and brutal honesty are back and sharper than ever.

A free demo will be released soon — until then, check out the trailer and hit that Wishlist button to let BOT.VINNIK know you’re still worthy of being called "comrade."
(YouTube™ embed: “BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy – Reveal Trailer”)

Thanks for all the support over the years!
See you at the Academy.


Rodrigo & Eduardo
Deep Green Games

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42471489/084ddadab27a86a52411acd976da250f6fbedd38.png
